sections.title: Return by whom to be verified.
sections.text_before_sub_clauses: The return of income under section 263 required to be furnished by the person specified in column B of the Table below shall be verified by the person specified in corresponding entry in column C of the said Table: 6. A company whose management has been taken over by the By the principal officer of the company. Central Government or any State Government under any law. 7. A company, for which application seeking corporate By the insolvency professional appointed by such Adjudicating Authority, where— insolvency resolution process has been admitted by the "Insolvency professional" and "Adjudicating Authority" shall have the same Adjudicating Authority under section 7 or 9 or 10 of the meanings as assigned to them respectively in sections 3(19) and 5(1) of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (31 of 2016). Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (31 of 2016). 8. A firm.

sub_clauses.text: By the managing partner of the firm;
where the managing partner is not able to verify the return due to any unavoidable reason, or there is no managing partner as such, by any partner of the firm, not being a minor.
By the designated partner of the limited liability partnership;

where the designated partner of the limited liability partnership is not able to verify the return due to any unavoidable reason, or where there is no designated partner, by any partner of the limited liability partnership or any other person as may be prescribed for verifying the return.

table.title: TABLE
columns: Sl. Person furnishing return of income No. A B

rows.column_B: (i) By the individual himself; (ii) where the individual is mentally incapacitated from attending to his affairs, by his guardian or any other person competent to act on his behalf; (iii) where, for any other reason, it is not possible for the individual to verify the return, by any person duly authorised by him through a valid power of attorney.
(i) By the karta; (ii) where the karta is absent from India or is mentally incapacitated from attending to his affairs, by any other adult member of such family.

rows.column_A: A company in cases other than those mentioned at serial numbers 4, 5, 6 and 7.
rows.column_B: (i) By the managing director of the company; (ii) where there is no managing director, or the managing director is not able to verify the return due to any unavoidable reason, by any director of the company or any other person as may be prescribed for verifying the return.

rows.column_A: A company not being resident in India.
rows.column_B: By any person holding a valid power of attorney from the company to do so.

table.linearized_text: Section (265): The return of income under section 263 required to be furnished by the person specified in column B of the Table below shall be verified by the person specified in corresponding entry in column C of the said Table: Table items: Item 1 — Sl. Person furnishing return of income No. A B: An individual.; To be verified C: (i) By the individual himself; (ii) where the individual is mentally incapacitated from attending to his affairs, by his guardian or any other person competent to act on his behalf; (iii) where, for any other reason, it is not possible for the individual to verify the return, by any person duly authorised by him through a valid power of attorney.. Item 2 — Sl. Person furnishing return of income No. A B: A Hindu undivided family.; To be verified C: (i) By the karta; (ii) where the karta is absent from India or is mentally incapacitated from attending to his affairs, by any other adult member of such family.. Item 3 — Sl. Person furnishing return of income No. A B: A company in cases other than those mentioned at serial numbers 4, 5, 6 and 7.; To be verified C: (i) By the managing director of the company; (ii) where there is no managing director, or the managing director is not able to verify the return due to any unavoidable reason, by any director of the company or any other person as may be prescribed for verifying the return.. Item 4 — Sl. Person furnishing return of income No. A B: A company not being resident in India.; To be verified C: By any person holding a valid power of attorney from the company to do so.. Item 5 — Sl. Person furnishing return of income No. A B: A company which is being wound up by orders of the Court or By the liquidator as referred to in section 322(1). otherwise, or where any person has been appointed as receiver of any assets of the company..
